headers: Create queries to search documents in SAP

records.Column_3:
SELECT 
    T3."callID",
    T1."DocNum" AS "Inventory Transfer ID",
    T1."DocDate",
    T1."TaxDate",
    T3."itemCode" AS "Serial No.",
    T2."ItemCode",
    T2."Dscription",
    T2."Quantity",
    T2."UomCode",
    T3."subject",
    T2."FromWhsCod",
    T2."WhsCode",
    U0."U_NAME"
FROM WTR1 T2 
    LEFT JOIN OWTR T1 ON T2."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry" 
    LEFT JOIN SCL4 T0 ON T1."DocNum" = T0."DocNumber" AND T0."Object" = 67
    LEFT JOIN OSCL T3 ON T0."SrcvCallID" = T3."callID"
    LEFT JOIN OUSR U0 ON T1."UserSign" = U0."USERID"
WHERE
    T2."ItemCode" IN ('17A-911-4680')
    AND (LOWER(T1."Comments") NOT LIKE ('%cancel%') OR T1."Comments" IS NULL)
    AND T1."CANCELED" = 'N'
ORDER BY T1."TaxDate" DESC
